client_brief:
Evening-led property campaign from an overcast shoot

Halcyon Quarter is a former ropeworks development. The audience is downsizers looking carefully at the place, not people buying a dramatic sky. Our capture day was overcast; the campaign needs a credible evening direction across very different placements.

Final handoff

 Halcyon Quarter launch hoarding: 1 named export. The development name is legible at the specified scale. The pictured building remains faithful to the supplied development image. The enquiry action is visible.

 Mixed-use launch poster: 1 named export. The residential and commercial offer is distinguishable. The developer identity is visible.

 Property portal campaign panel: 1 named export. The approved location appears correctly. The composition does not imply completed construction where the source is a proposal.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Off-plan residential development launch on a former rope works site, sold through a boutique brokerage with a partner lender, real estate and property.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Beckett Wharf, Providence, Rhode Island. Halcyon Quarter is fifty two apartments by the developer Kestrel and Vane, phase one releasing in seven weeks, sold by Harbor Crest Realty with Kestrel Home Lending as finance partner.
brand_identity.about: Halcyon Quarter is a fifty two apartment scheme by Kestrel and Vane on the old rope works site at Beckett Wharf. Phase one sells to professional downsizers leaving a family home nearby. What the scheme sells is the evening: warm rooms against a cool blue hour on the water, quiet and expensive rather than shiny, carried across the developer, the brokerage and the lender as one look.
brand_identity.audience: Professional downsizers aged 50 to 65 leaving a house they have owned for thirty years within twenty miles. Discerning, unhurried, distrustful of shiny marketing, and likely to count windows when they visit the site.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Premium off-plan residential, apartments from 780 thousand to 1.45 million dollars. Positioned as quiet and expensive, above bright price-led property marketing and apart from investor rental stock.
brand_identity.typography: Halcyon Quarter is built around the fit. Step 01 is the development name in Domaine Display Narrow Regular at 120 pt on 126 pt with tracking of minus 8 units on the A2 poster, optically sized to fill the text measure exactly, which is 380 pt across the 1200 mm hoarding and 68 px on the portal panel, always inside generous margins. Step 02 is the standfirst in the same face at 30 pt on 34 pt with tracking of minus 4 units. Step 03 is body in Graphik Regular at 12 pt on 17 pt, tracking 0, held to a maximum of 65 characters, and 20 px on the portal, with the price kept inside the sentence in tabular lining figures at 28 pt. Step 04 is captions, specification and credits in Graphik Regular at 9 pt on 13 pt with tracking of plus 10 units and tabular lining figures. A price is never set in Graphik Bold and never in a starburst.
brand_identity.voice: Calm, assured and understated. Brass not gold, the water cold and the rooms warm, nothing shiny. We state the address, the light and the offer without overselling. Example line: 'Fifty two apartments on the water at Beckett Wharf, releasing this autumn.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The Kestrel and Vane monogram exists only as sign paint, brushed by the sign writer onto the site hoarding board, with a single photograph of it and no artwork file. The lender's payment cards survive only as the flat file their printer ran last spring, with no working source held by anyone, and every figure has since changed.
brand_identity.values: Honesty about an off-plan scheme (nothing shown that the building does not have) and one restrained look shared across developer, brokerage and lender.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: The name is always optically sized to fill the full text measure exactly, from 380 pt on the hoarding to 68 px on the portal panel, so it is as wide as the piece allows every time.

scale.note: A2 poster size. The name is optically sized to fill the text measure exactly, 380 pt across the 1200 mm hoarding and 68 px on the portal panel, always inside generous margins.

scale.sample: Fifty two apartments at Beckett Wharf
scale.note: Standfirst beneath the full measure name. No size existed for this step, so 30 pt was set to hold a clean step from the 120 pt name down to 12 pt body.

scale.sample: Warm rooms on the water, on the old rope works site.
scale.note: Max 65 characters. Portal body 20 px. The price runs inside the sentence at 28 pt, tabular lining.

scale.sample: Developed by Kestrel and Vane. Sold by Harbor Crest Realty.
scale.note: Captions, specification and credits, tabular lining figures. A price never drops to this step; it stays inside the sentence at 28 pt.

type_system.signature_move: The name is always optically sized to fill the full text measure exactly, 380 pt across the 1200 mm hoarding, 120 pt on the A2 poster and 68 px on the portal panel, so it is as wide as the piece allows every time, inside generous margins.
rules: Never set a price in Graphik Bold and never in a starburst.
The price stays inside the sentence, in Graphik Regular tabular lining figures at 28 pt.
The development name is always optically fitted to the full text measure, never set short of it and never outside the generous margins.
Captions, specification and prices are Graphik Regular only.
Show nothing the building does not have.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
Generated sky or architecture may be presented only as a clearly labeled concept, never as truthful property photography.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
